title: MMI Notation conformance case
description: One executable example of MMI Notation v1 (mmi-notation-v1.md §12). A case declares input files, an input Markdown document, and substrings that MUST (expectContains) / MUST NOT (expectNotContains) appear in the rendered output of a conforming processor at the given level. Files are created relative to the Markdown document's directory.

spec.description: Clause reference in mmi-notation-v1.md, e.g. '§6 step 5'.

files.description: Relative path -> literal file content, created next to the Markdown document.
